employer_specifics: Maze builds an AI-native vulnerability management platform: autonomous agents that investigate, triage and remediate cloud security findings 'the way a senior analyst would'; agents run multi-step non-deterministic trajectories across a toolset of 180+ tools, tested against a ground-truth exploit lab the company built.

The core problem of the role is evaluation of non-deterministic multi-step agents: trajectory evaluation, ground-truth scoring against the exploit lab, LLM-as-judge, measuring fine-tuning results — 'this capability is rare and it's the one we most want'.

Founded 2024 in London by Harry Wetherald (CEO) and Adrian Jozwik; team from Amazon, Elastic and Tessian; $6M seed (Cherry Ventures) + $25M Series A led by Theory Ventures (Jun 2025); Series B 'on the horizon'; agents in production at 10+ organisations including two Fortune 200.
